blind.description: A classical architectural stone balustrade section consisting of a long horizontal top railing (handrail), seven vertical turned balusters/spindles with bulbous classical profiles, and a solid rectangular base rail. The entire surface is light beige/grey aged marble or carved stone with weathered mossy green-brown staining and grime seams along the joints. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and continuous with no holes, shards, or floating elements. Sits flat directly on its base.
blind.from_above: A long, narrow rectangle showing the top surface of the carved stone handrail with slight seam lines and weathered patches, casting a shadow that clearly displays the silhouettes of the individual balusters.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third to two-fifths the height of the figure (around 2 ft to 2.5 ft tall) and about as long as the figure is tall (approx. 5.5 to 6 ft long).
